com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick

Interface HistoricalTickRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultHistoricalTickRequest, IntradayHistoricalTickRequest

    public interface HistoricalTickRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this interface is to provide a request for both Tick and Intraday data. It provides several methods to turn on/off options along with getters/setters.

    If requesting with Count then the response will be generated for the given count starting backwards from EndDate. Otherwise the response will be generated from EndDate to BeginDate.

    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

      • setServerTurnAround

        void setServerTurnAround(java.lang.Long serverTurnAround)
        This value was introduced for performance reasons. Add this as part of the request in order to optimize the results fetched out of Tick History database. This is very useful in the "drag chart" functionality. Request only the records required to draw the chart. In the next request if user chooses to drag the chart backwards, pass this server turnaround value along with all the other parameters and it will save the database lookup time.

        Remember, this value is not available for the first request.

        Parameters:
        serverTurnAround - Value of server turnaround.
